units.source_text: 傍晚五点，四郎兵卫（一位远亲的老人，虽说他是远亲，只是名义而已，

en.t: At five o'clock in the evening, Shirobei, an elderly distant relative, though he was called a distant relative only in name,

units.source_text: 其实毫无血缘关系，祖父同他过从也不甚密切）探病来了。

en.t: in fact had no blood relation to us at all, and my grandfather was not especially close to him, came to visit him in his illness.
He comforted my grandfather in many ways.
